description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Lightning 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Federation Blackblood Mode], [Play Rough Mode] and [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to the user

description.name: Attach Lightning 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Federation Blackblood Mode
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to user when any Damage Reduction Barrier is removed, removed after triggering five times or if user hasn't [Synchro Mode]

description.name: Play Rough Mode
description.text: MAG +30%, DEF and RES -30%, cast speed x3.00

description.name: 40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 40% for the next attack
